name: 示例捆绑包
description: 捆绑包(bundle)开发模板:一个 Forsion 插件目录内嵌引擎插件(tangu-plugins/)、Agent+技能(agents/)与 Space(spaces/),装一处全就位。
descriptionEn: Bundle template: one Forsion plugin folder that ships an engine plugin (tangu-plugins/), an agent with its skills (agents/) and a Space (spaces/), all in place after a single install.

onboarding.intro: 「打个招呼」要先知道怎么称呼你,填上称呼才能用;引擎工具、Agent 与 Space 装完即就位。

steps.title: 看引擎侧
steps.description: 重启/重扫引擎后:设置 → 插件 的引擎区能看到 sample-bundle-tool 由本包捆绑提供(随本插件启停);Agents 页出现「示例捆绑助手」(播种一次,插件升级不覆盖、卸载也保留)。

steps.title: 看 Space
steps.description: 左侧 ribbon 出现「示例捆绑 Space」,随本插件启停显隐;禁用插件它就收起。

steps.title: 试一试
steps.description: 命令面板跑「示例捆绑包:打个招呼」;或让「示例捆绑助手」调 sample_bundle_echo 工具回显一句话。

en.intro: Say hello needs to know what to call you, so fill in your name first. The engine tool, agent and Space are ready as soon as the bundle is installed.

steps.title: Check the engine side
steps.description: After restarting or rescanning the engine, the engine section of Settings → Plugins lists sample-bundle-tool as provided by this bundle (it turns on and off with this plugin). The Agents page shows the bundled sample assistant (seeded once: plugin updates never overwrite it and uninstalling keeps it).

steps.title: Check the Space
steps.description: The left ribbon shows Sample Bundle Space, which appears and hides with this plugin. Disable the plugin and it folds away.

steps.title: Try it
steps.description: Run "Sample bundle: say hello" from the command palette, or ask the bundled sample assistant to echo a sentence with the sample_bundle_echo tool.
